    enhancedMonitorService: true,

    password: "Password@123",

            mountTarget: "/var/data",
            diskPartition: "/dev/vdb",
        },
        extraArgs: {
            kubelets: ["root-dir=/root"],
        },
        taints: [{
            key: "key",
            value: "value",
            effect: "NoSchedule",
        }],
    },
});
